preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row must have exactly m columns.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in ('.', 'X') for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell must be either '.' (unmarked) or 'X' (marked).

preconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] != 'X' or (1 < i < n-1 and 1 < j < m-1) for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: No marked cells are adjacent to the edge of the grid.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' implies len(return_value) == n + 1 and all(len(row) == m for row in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', there must be n+1 lines, with each subsequent line having m space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' implies all(cell in (1, 4) for row in return_value[1:] for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Every unmarked cell must contain either the number 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' implies all(grid[i][j] == 'X' implies sum(return_value[i+1][k] for k in range(max(0, j-1), min(m, j+2)) if k != j) % 5 == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Every marked cell must contain a multiple of 5, which is the sum of the numbers in all unmarked cells adjacent to it.
